builds.title: Dracon gangway keeper, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 fighter. THAC0 20 before modifiers. One weapon attack or two racial claw attacks.
traits: Lawful good. HP 8 on 1d10. The original companion Dracon entry supplies innate AC 5. He wears cloth and carries a medium shield for AC 4 from the front. Dexterity 13 makes no AC adjustment.
His body counts as Large when selecting a weapon's damage column. The lighter load on his fitted back harness allows move 18.
Base saves. Paralysis/poison/death 14, rod/staff/wand 16, petrification/polymorph 15, breath 17, spell 17.
actions: Long sword, THAC0 20. Hit for 1d8+1 against a Small or Medium target or 1d12+1 against a Large target. Speed factor 5.
Thumb-claws with both hands free, two attacks at THAC0 20. Each hit deals 1d4+1 including Strength. Stow the sword and shield first.
Shoulder a jammed door. Add 4 to the normal Strength 16 opening target of 9, for a result of 13 or less on 1d20.
builds.tactics: Perrin braces the gangway as the others unlash the cargo. He offers safe passage to anyone who helps get the doors open.

builds.title: Giff quartermaster, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 fighter. Base THAC0 20. One attack per round.
traits: Lawful neutral. HP 8 on 1d10 plus 2 for Constitution 16. Russet coat with no armor. Natural AC 6 improves to 5 with the medium shield.
Count as Large against weapon damage. Use 10% resistance against incoming hostile or helpful spells. Resolve unsuitable item malfunction separately. Leda carries mundane gear.
Base saves. Paralysis/poison/death 14, rod/staff/wand 16, petrification/polymorph 15, breath 17, spell 17.
actions: Battle axe, THAC0 19. Hit for 1d8+1 against Small, Medium or Large targets. Speed factor 7.
Head-butt, THAC0 19, 2d6 damage. Use this unarmed option instead of the axe. The printed head-butt damage is used as a fixed expression.
builds.tactics: Leda orders the crew clear of the open hatch, holds behind the shield and keeps the manifest safe in her coat.

builds.title: Grommam topside rigger, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 fighter. Base THAC0 20. The smaller off-hand dagger grants one extra attack when both weapons are in use.
traits: Lawful good. HP 9 on 1d10. No armor or shield. Dexterity 15 improves AC 10 to 9.

The species climbing bonus is +25 percentage points when the DM calls for a percentage climbing roll. Tree movement comes from the original companion Grommam entry. Ship rigging uses normal climbing procedures.
A magic item unsuitable for his class has a 40% per-use failure chance, with the listed exceptions. He carries mundane tools.
Base saves. Paralysis/poison/death 14, rod/staff/wand 16, petrification/polymorph 15, breath 17, spell 17.
actions: Hand axe, THAC0 19. Hit for 1d6+1 against a Small or Medium target or 1d4+1 against a Large target. Speed factor 4.

Add a dagger in the off hand for a two-weapon round. Roll one axe attack as above and one dagger attack at THAC0 19 for 1d4+1 against a Small or Medium target or 1d3+1 against a Large target. The lower attack target reflects Strength 17 and the species waiver. Dagger speed factor 2.
builds.tactics: Serren goes up the rigging to cut a fouled line, then covers the descent. He keeps one hand free while climbing.

builds.title: Hurwaeti salvage guard, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 fighter. Base THAC0 20. One attack per round or use the daily fog bank.
traits: Neutral. HP 8 on 1d10. Natural AC 5, medium shield −1 and Dexterity 16 −2 give AC 2 with shield facing. No worn armor. Use Dexterity's +1 reaction adjustment for surprise.
May leap 8 feet straight up or 20 feet horizontally with gear. The swim rate comes from the original companion Hurwaet entry.
Base saves. Paralysis/poison/death 14, rod/staff/wand 16, petrification/polymorph 15, breath 17, spell 17. Apply the Dexterity adjustment when the rules call for a dodgeable save.
actions: Spear thrust, THAC0 20. Hit for 1d6+1 against a Small or Medium target or 1d8+1 against a Large target. Speed factor 6. Against the listed enemies the effective THAC0 improves to 19.

Throw spear once, THAC0 19 at short range with Dexterity's +1. Use the same damage and the same conditional racial hit bonus. Bands 10/20/30 yd. outdoors or ft. indoors, with the usual −2 and −5 at medium and long range.

Fog bank once per day. Stationary 60 × 60 × 20 ft., no save. Sight stops past 2 feet through it. For this encounter, use the PHB spell's 10 yd. placement range and 2 initiative modifier with a seven-round base duration. A strong breeze clears it in a round and a moderate one halves its duration. Dispelling does not clear it. May use the same daily fog to refresh a ship's air as described in the profile.
builds.tactics: Venn makes the crossing first and puts fog between the crew and onlookers when the cargo comes out.

concepts.name: Perrin Broadwake
concepts.motive: Keep a leaking hold clear while the crew moves provisions.
concepts.hook: The emergency hatch jammed under a shifted pallet. Perrin needs a second pair of hands before he can put down his shield.

concepts.name: Leda Caskmark
concepts.motive: Find which two crates were signed out with the wrong cargo marks.
concepts.hook: Leda offers crew pay to recover two crates before their owners notice the mix-up.

concepts.name: Serren Knotwright
concepts.motive: Free a tangled cargo sling without dropping it into the harbor.
concepts.hook: Serren signals for help from above. A frayed line is holding the whole load.

concepts.name: Venn Reedstep
concepts.motive: Bring a sealed logbook back before the wreck breaks loose.
concepts.hook: Venn can screen the recovery with fog or save it for a small launch whose air is going foul.
